features: POWERFUL OUTPUT: With a powerful 24W RMS output, delivers robust, immersive sound ideal for parties, gatherings, or personal use.
DUAL PASSIVE RADIATORS: Dual passive radiators enhance bass performance, delivering deeper, richer low-frequency sounds for a balanced, full-bodied audio experience.
MULTI-CONNECTIVITY: Offers multiple connectivity options including BT v5.3, USB, and AUX, providing flexible and stable connections to various audio sources.
DUAL DRIVERS: Powerful dual drivers deliver clear, dynamic sound across a wide frequency range for precise and immersive audio.
LED INDICATOR: Built-in LED indicator provides clear visual cues for power and connectivity status.
LONGER PLAYTIME: Built-in rechargeable battery offers up to 8* hours (*at 50% volume, LED off) of playback with convenient Type-C charging.
MULTICOLOR LED: Customizable multicolor LED modes add vibrant visual effects, enhancing the overall listening experience.
CONTROLS: Intuitive media and volume controls allow easy adjustment of audio settings without needing to access your connected device.
